decisions.rationale: Ectopic Atrial Tachycardia does not match the clinical presentation
Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) with variable atrioventricular block matches the ECG findings and clinical presentation
Atrial Tachycardia with variable block is a broader category that could encompass the patient's condition
Atrial Flutter with variable conduction does not match the ECG findings
